identity_binding.corpus: content-addressed included-path bytes for each named corpus at the bound Git subject or pinned public commit/tree
identity_binding.evaluator: independent G2 evaluator-subject pin; blocked_until_g2_trusted_sandbox in this slice
identity_binding.suite_manifest: sha256 of this suite file and of the hidden-holdout hash-manifest
identity_binding.comparison_rule: A later baseline/candidate comparison is valid only when all five identities match. Changing any one invalidates the comparison. A legitimate evaluator revision requires a separately reviewed protocol revision and a new baseline.

notes: Local advisory runner executes only the visible development fixture through the existing harness. It emits pass/block/indeterminate evidence bound to a clean Git subject. Hidden holdout access, candidate-independent acceptance, and promotion remain deferred to G2/AVO.
